hook.name: Sivo UniswapHook
hook.description: Oracle-priced Uniswap v4 hook for the Sivo SLP token. Absorbs stablecoin-to-SLP swaps at the Chainlink NAV price using BeforeSwapDelta custom accounting, bypassing the AMM curve entirely. SLP exits are handled via an async FIFO redemption queue filled by inbound deposits and operator replenishment. Third-party liquidity and donations are blocked.
